title: Is drone warfare (FPV) considered insensitive to include in games?
author: No_Departure7494
selftext:
I don't think it's arbitrary. It's the same as - Why can we make fun of people on the Titanic dying but not \*insert modern tragedy\*? 

It seems desirable as a gameplay mechanic but too nascent and callus to actually add it in. Flying FPV drones into soldiers, dropping the small thermobaric grenades into trenches. Too real in the current wars now, too close to home.

That is my opinion but I am seeking the opinions of others.

comments.body:

Also Drones are currently in many modern war video games.
